title: Internal backend hostname disclosed (X-Backend-Server header)
description: The response carries an X-Backend-Server header naming the internal host that served it. The value is usually an internal DNS name or a datacentre identifier that is not meant to be reachable from outside, and it maps the public endpoint onto internal infrastructure.
remediation: Strip the header at the edge, or rename the value to an opaque request identifier. If the application sets it for correlation, send that correlation value to the log sink instead of the client.
limitation: One header value. The rule reports the header content; it cannot tell whether the named host is reachable from the internet or what runs on it.
